about_the_game:
What lies in wait for you deep behind the walls of Aperture?

Reliquiae is a mod for Portal 2 that recreates Portal 1's behind-the-scenes style perfectly. Proudly boasting a darker and more overwhelming feel compared to other mods, Reliquiae's unique story and characters set it apart from its contemporaries.

Mike Daas' original Reliquiae puzzle series released on the Portal 2 workshop in 2020. Arguably a legend in puzzle design, Daas' original vision is recreated, redecorated, and remastered in this mod, breathing new life into one of his most iconic series.

With crucial attention to detail and decoration, Reliquiae features Portal 1 BTS environments like never seen before - a unique blend of maze-like levels, carefully manufactured destruction, and way too many cables. Unlike many other mods, Reliquiae contains no new mechanics, instead focusing whole-heartedly on its story, its atmosphere, and its design.

This mod contains serious and mature themes and is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

Team:

Hazel Webbs: Lead Dev, Story, Mapper, VA
Ashleyanna Rivers: Graphical Designer, Story, Composer, VA
Mike Daas: Puzzle Designer, VA
Forrest DePoy / Xay: VA

Special Thanks:

Portal Mapping and Modding: Playtesting, General Assistance
Teamspen210 / Kelsey: VScripting Assistance
Mike Daas YT Community: Funding

content_descriptors.notes: Gore, body mutilation, suicidal themes, and audio depictions of violence.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Dual core from Intel or AMD at 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 8600/9600GT, ATI/AMD Radeon HD2600/3600 (Graphic Drivers: nVidia 310, AMD 12.11), OpenGL 2.1
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

name: Reliquiae

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / Vista / XP
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0 (or higher) or AMD64X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 128 MB or more and with support for Pixel Shader 2.0b (ATI Radeon X800 or higher / NVIDIA GeForce 7600 or higher / Intel HD Graphics 2000 or higher).
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible
  • Additional Notes: Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

short_description: Reliquiae is a mod for Portal 2 that perfectly recreates its prequel's behind-the-scenes environment. With immersive, chilling soundscapes and uniquely dark environments, Reliquiae will take you on an unsettling journey behind the walls of Aperture Laboratories.
